rule.description: Among graded recipes with exploration coverage >= 95% that beat the industry median in at least 3 of 4 exploration years, pick the one with the lowest exploration median |error| for each multiple.

runs.name: ebitda_expensed_investment_gap
runs.compact: EV/EBITDA | screen same industry_l3 | rank gross_margin 1, ebitda_margin 1, sales_growth_1y 1, net_debt_to_ebitda 0.5 | k=8, median, min_peers=5 | fallback [same industry_l2] -> []

runs.name: g03-04 pricing-power and reinvestment EV/EBITDA
runs.compact: EV/EBITDA | screen same industry_l2 | rank gross_margin 1, capex_intensity 1.5, ebit_margin 1, sales_growth_1y 1, log_assets 0.5 | k=12, median, min_peers=5

runs.name: g02-01 EBITDA sector drivers with D&A wedge
runs.compact: EV/EBITDA | screen same industry_l2 | rank ebitda_margin 1, ebit_margin 1, roic 1, sales_growth_1y 1, net_debt_to_ebitda 0.5 | k=12, trimmed_mean, min_peers=6 | fallback []

runs.name: ebitda_transitory_margin_l2
runs.compact: EV/EBITDA | screen same industry_l2 | rank ebitda_margin 2, asset_turnover 1, sales_growth_1y 1 | k=10, median, min_peers=5 | fallback []

runs.name: ebitda_capex_conversion_within_l2
runs.compact: EV/EBITDA | screen same industry_l2 | rank capex_intensity 1.5, ebitda_margin 1, sales_growth_1y 1 | k=10, median, min_peers=5 | fallback []

runs.name: sales_crossindustry_profitability_twins
runs.compact: EV/Sales | rank ebitda_margin 2, gross_margin 1, sales_growth_1y 1, capex_intensity 0.5, asset_turnover 0.5 | k=15, median, min_peers=5

runs.name: sales_crossindustry_margin_band
runs.compact: EV/Sales | screen band ebitda_margin±0.04 | rank ebitda_margin 2, sales_growth_1y 1, roic 1, log_sales 0.5 | k=12, median, min_peers=5 | fallback [band ebitda_margin±0.1] -> []

runs.name: g02-04 Sales economic-margin band (R&D add-back)
runs.compact: EV/Sales | screen band ebitda_margin±0.04 | rank rnd_intensity 1.5, sales_growth_1y 1, roic 1, capex_intensity 0.5 | k=12, median, min_peers=6 | fallback [band ebitda_margin±0.08] -> []

runs.name: g03-06 margin-and-growth box across sectors (EV/Sales)
runs.compact: EV/Sales | screen band ebitda_margin±0.03, band sales_growth_1y±0.1 | rank gross_margin 1, rnd_intensity 1, asset_turnover 1 | k=10, median, min_peers=5 | fallback [band ebitda_margin±0.03] -> [band ebitda_margin±0.06] -> []

runs.name: L3 margin band with nested widening
runs.compact: EV/Sales | screen same industry_l3, band ebitda_margin±0.04 | rank sales_growth_1y 1, rnd_intensity 1, gross_margin 0.5 | k=6, harmonic_mean, min_peers=3 | fallback [same industry_l2, band ebitda_margin±0.04] -> [band ebitda_margin±0.04] -> [band ebitda_margin±0.08] -> []
